# Nikala UI

> A simple, copy-paste component system for SolidJS built natively for Tailwind CSS v4. Honoring Georgian painter Niko Pirosmani (Nikala).

## Key Features
- Native SolidJS Reactivity (built with splitProps)
- Tailwind CSS v4 First (@import "tailwindcss"; with semantic tokens)
- SolidJS & SolidStart Ready (Vite, Tauri, Electron, SolidStart SSR)
- Full Code Ownership (components live in src/components/ui)
- Smart CLI tool (nikala init, nikala add, nikala theme)

## Quick Start
npx nikala init
nikala add button input card theme-manager

## Core Concepts
- Always use splitProps to preserve SolidJS signal reactivity.
- Dynamic Theme Engine supporting base grays (zinc, slate, stone) and brand accents (wine, sky, violet, emerald).
